title: USB Gym: A Gymnasium Testbed for Closed-Loop Ultrasound View Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.08352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough.   Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory.   Results:

translated_title: USB Gym：一个用于闭环超声视图匹配的Gymnasium测试平台
translated_abstract: 背景与目标：我们的主要目标是超声引导，即移动超声探头直到其图像与目标视图相匹配。目前已发表的方法中，引导系统的各个部分通常在不同的模拟器中分别评估。我们想探究的问题是：将这些方法组合成一个完整的引导系统后，是否足够好用。方法：我们构建了USB Gym测试平台，其标准引擎基于公开的患者CT数据模拟超声图像，并利用一个从CT标签中提取器官纹理的网络。该引导系统包含三个可替换的部件（插槽）：器官分割器、控制器和奖励函数，共纳入了20种已发表的方法，每种方法均在相同的六名留出患者的60个回合上运行。在每个插槽中，只有当已发表的方法在这些患者上表现出可检测的更优性能时，才会替换我们原有的方法。将这一最优组合与我们原始的引导系统在20个新CT数据上的表现进行比较，其中较优者作为基准基线。此外，一个姿态神谕读取仅在仿真环境中才能获得的精确探头姿态，作为参考标准。以下结果为探索性结果。
tldr: 提出了USB Gym——一个基于公开CT数据模拟超声的闭环超声视图匹配标准化测试平台，通过可替换插槽机制系统评估并组合20种已发表方法，为超声引导研究建立了统一可比较的基准。
en_tdlr: USB Gym, a standardized Gymnasium testbed for closed-loop ultrasound view matching that simulates ultrasound from public patient CT data and systematically benchmarks 20 published methods across interchangeable guide components (segmenter, controller, and reward).
